senses.gloss: f. (a Babyl. corrupt. of קָטָבוֹלְיָא) leather cover, spread.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 79a">Sabb. 79ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>ההיא בק׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>בקורטבלא</he>, Ar. <he>בקרטב׳</he>) this refers to a leather spread.
<cite ref="Chagigah 24a:3">Ḥag. 24ᵃ</cite> <he>שצברן ע״ג קרטב׳</he> (Ms. M. <cite ref="S00698"><he>קָטָבְלָא</he></cite>) he piled them on a leather spread.
<cite ref="Niddah 28a:12">Nidd. 28ᵃ</cite> <he>שרפו ע״ג קטבלא</he> he burned the corpse on a leather spread (which is not consumed in fire).
